name: How long does a typical concrete sidewalk repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical concrete sidewalk repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a concrete sidewalk repair varies significantly based on the repair method and the extent of the damage. Small crack repairs might take a few hours. For concrete leveling (slabjacking) of a section, the work could be completed within a day. A full replacement of a sidewalk section can take 1-3 days, including removal, preparation, pouring, and initial curing. We provide a time estimate after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary; small fixes take hours, while larger leveling or replacement jobs can take 1-3 days depending on the scope.
